text: We don’t have enough evidence to confirm whether the asset is deforestation-free. The available Earth-observation data (Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020, MGAP 2021) doesn’t cover this asset, so no observations were made for the period 2021–2025. This means we can’t rule out tree-cover loss, nor can we confirm it happened. The evidence is insufficient for any compliance claim (e.g., EUDR compliance or deforestation-free status). Further data or on-site verification would be needed to answer the question.
